title: Bash syntax gate before test run

parsed.summary: Bash syntax preflight is wired in before the test gate in both target scripts, full verification passed, and the scope anomaly is limited to runtime/bookkeeping artifacts rather than coder-owned task changes.
parsed.progress_note: R19-02 is acceptable as implemented: modified `.sh` files are syntax-checked before `make test`, syntax failure short-circuits the test run, and the reported out-of-scope files are bookkeeping/audit artifacts rather than missing product work for this task.
